content: For the Thai sentence segmentation task, our model is superior to all the baselines on both Thai sentence segmentation datasets, as shown in Table TABREF45 . On the Orchid dataset, the supervised model that includes both local and distant representation was adopted for comparison to the baseline model. Our model improves the F1 score achieved by CRF-ngram, which is the state-of-the-art model for Thai sentence segmentation in Orchid, from 91.9% (row (d)) to 92.5% (row (g)). Meanwhile, in the UGWC dataset, our CVT model (row (h)) achieves an F1 score of 88.9%, which is higher than the F1 score of both the baselines (CRF-ngram and Bi-LSTM-CRF (rows d and e, respectively)). Thus, our model is now the state-of-the-art model for Thai sentence segmentation on both the Orchid and UGWC datasets.
